notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
New update for Dream #46 (v1.4). Here are the changes :


 Finishing the game no longer delete save file
 The boat's speed now increases for each flower collected
 Backwards speed increased
 Steering the boat while idle or going backwards is now faster. Associated visuals added/updated
 Edited one Positive Thinking FR translation
 Using the teleporter no longer requires to look at it. Now you only need to be in the teleporter trigger area, and honk

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
New update for Dream #46 (v1.3). Here are the changes :


 Fixed a broken Steam achievement
 Modified translation "Wake Up" by "Wake Up (Save & Exit)"
 Camera orientation now can be precisely controlled with analog joysticks from the gamepad
